notes: A center dot stays on the map, and the place name and forecast follow it after you pan.
Splash logo is radar rings on a clear background, without a square tile.
NWS alerts use each hazard’s own color, a lighter fill, and open the full message when tapped.
Startup splash stays up for 7 seconds from the moment the page opens, including a home-screen launch.
Smooth radar: soft contours instead of blocky gates, and light clutter under about 20 dBZ hidden.
Smooth playback: every frame preloads, then crossfades on a steady clock without skipping.
Version and Pacific build time shown in Settings.
A 7-second startup splash while the first radar frames load.
Compact phone layout: slim header, thin legend, and a short playback bar.
Doppler product picker for KBBX and KDAX, including base velocity, storm-relative velocity, hydrometeors, and precipitation.
Update tab to check for a new build and reload when you choose.
